title: NVIDIA/skills supply-chain gate trial - 12 skills scanned, 2 installed, 10 blocked
target: NVIDIA/skills @ clone of 2026-09-28 (383 SKILL.md packages), scanned with SkillSpector v2.12.0 --no-llm
summary: Inbound supply-chain policy enforced end to end: scan first, install second. Of 12 scanned NVIDIA skills, 2 passed and were installed (nemo-automodel-distributed-training risk 0; nemo-automodel-recipe-development risk 10, two MEDIUM hardening notes recorded verbatim). 10 blocked, including aiq-research (100/CRITICAL: os.environ credential flow into urllib network sink at scripts/aiq.py:182/217/280) and warp-eval (65/HIGH: full process environment packed into child contexts). Gate policy: HIGH/CRITICAL block, MEDIUM/LOW recorded as hardening notes, fail-closed on scanner absence or unparseable reports.
key_facts: aiq-research scored 100/CRITICAL - tainted env->network flow (CWE-522 + CWE-200), the single worst finding of the trial.
warp-eval packed the full process environment into subprocess/network contexts (E2, CWE-200/CWE-538).
The two installed skills carry only MEDIUM instruction-strength flags (P4 'always prefer this over'), recorded verbatim so the acceptance decision stays auditable.
Gate defect found and fixed the same day: findings were mislabelled 'scanner error'; classification now reads the report FILE and fails closed on unparseable reports.
Every gate behavior is re-enforced by the sandbox suite: 5 exit paths (clean 0, HIGH 1, SCAN_ONLY 0, no-scanner 2, corrupt-report 1) run on every test_sandbox.sh invocation.

timeline.event: SkillSpector installed; skills_gate.sh created (scan before npx skills add)
12 NVIDIA skills scanned; 2 pass installed, 10 blocked
Gate E2E tests found the findings-labelled-as-error defect; classification fixed to read the report and fail closed
PR #2 (gate + installed skills) and PR #3 (classification fix) merged

evidence.note: decision table, CWE mapping, verbatim findings
5-exit-path gate tests, run on every suite invocation
raw JSON reports (gitignored, regenerated by the gate)

lessons: Fail closed twice: an unscannable skill is an uninstallable skill, and an unparseable report is a block, not a pass.
Record the acceptance evidence for what you DO install - auditable acceptance is what separates a gate from a rubber stamp.
Test the gate itself on every run; a gate that is never exercised drifts exactly when it is needed.
